q: Incomes are right-skewed. Which is usually larger?
why: A tail of high values pulls the mean up.

q: Which measure of spread ignores extreme values?
why: The IQR uses only the middle half.

q: A large sample is always a good sample.
why: Myth. A biased sample (say, only online volunteers) stays biased however large.
